atomic_outcome: An atom may declare a structured field it introduces: start accepts it when the field's parent resolves and the leaf does not exist yet, records it as introduced, and record-promotion refuses until the canonical module carries the leaf; a misspelled field and an introduced flag on an existing field are refused at start by name.
expected_outcome: An introduced flag on a field the module already carries is refused by name.
operator_path: Run the candidate controller's real start against the real United Partners repository for every frozen request and its promotion-time validation for the introduced field; promoted validation then starts the real round-5 request through the installed controller.
overall_criterion: Any metric fails on any case, or the promoted controller refuses the real request.
